sovereign_country.strategic_role: 极速离岸证券与外汇交易商持牌（VFSC）、轻资产免税出海

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Physical Wholesale Brokerage of Marine Fuel Oil and Distillates

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Vanuatu (International Company Regime, Vanuatu Financial Services Commission)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid: English common law tradition with French civil law influence, customary law recognition, and statute-based commercial law; unitary national jurisdiction with no sub-state tax or fiscal distinctions.
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: No comprehensive BIT or DTAA currently in force; Vanuatu operates a territorial zero-income-tax regime for International Companies.
Tax Information Exchange Agreement (TIEA) between the Republic of Vanuatu and Australia (2010).
Tax Information Exchange Agreement (TIEA) between the Republic of Vanuatu and New Zealand (2010).
Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations (PACER-Plus) — Vanuatu is a signatory with Australia and New Zealand.
World Trade Organization (WTO) — Vanuatu has been a Member since 24 August 2012.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act [Cap. 222] as amended (including the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2017 on UBO record-keeping and the 2019 amendments on economic substance); Anti-Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing Act 2017 (Act No. 43 of 2017) and the VFSC AML/CFT Rulebook and Guidance Notes; Financial Dealers (Anti-Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing) Act 2016 (Act No. 11 of 2016) applicable to the Licensed Registered Agent; Companies Act [Cap. 191] and VFSC directives on beneficial ownership; Counter-Terrorism and Transnational Organised Crime Act [Cap. 126].
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access — UBO information is recorded with the Licensed Registered Agent and filed with the VFSC; accessible to the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit (VFIU), State Law Office and designated AML supervisors; not publicly searchable.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of passport of each director, shareholder and ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport-issuing authority or notary public of the holder's country
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (1961 Convention, applicable to Vanuatu) for originating Hague states; otherwise consular legalization via Vanuatu High Commission in Canberra or competent honorary consulate

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement, dated within 3 months)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider or account-holding financial institution
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization plus Hague Apostille or consular legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter (original, signed, with at least 6 months account tenure)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized signature; apostille or consular legalization if required by the Registered Agent's EDD policy

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Professional reference letter (lawyer or certified accountant)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization plus apostille or consular legalization as applicable

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of incorporation and certificate of good standing of corporate shareholders
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent companies registry of the shareholder's jurisdiction of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization; certification date within 90 days of lodgement

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Source of Wealth and Source of Funds declaration (energy trading origin)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization plus apostille or consular legalization; corroborative bank and financial statements attached

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Curriculum vitae and professional profile of proposed directors and beneficial owners
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Applicant and UBOs, certified by a notary
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization; apostille or consular legalization if signature certification is required

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory automated and manual screening against UN Security Council Consolidated List, OFAC SDN, UK HMT, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions Database, Australian DFAT Consolidated List and VFIU domestic lists; FATF-compliant PEP definition covering foreign, domestic and international-organization PEPs plus family members and close associates; mandatory enhanced due diligence and senior-management approval for PEPs and for ISIC 4661 high-risk energy commodity trading, standby SBLC arrangements, SWIFT wire corridors and transactions involving high-risk jurisdictions; ongoing transaction monitoring and re-screening at least every 12 months.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) International Companies Registry — official name clearance and reservation processed through the VFSC e-Registry portal and licensed Registered Agents (https://www.vfsc.vu).
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Names must be in Latin (Roman) script and in English or French (Vanuatu official languages); any non-Roman or vernacular name must be transliterated and registered only as a secondary name; required suffix: Limited, Corporation, Incorporated, Société Anonyme, or abbreviations (Ltd, Corp, Inc, SA).
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Words implying government or royal patronage: Government, National, Royal, Commonwealth, Emperor, Patron
Regulated financial and insurance tokens requiring prior regulator approval: Bank, Banking, Trust, Trustee, Assurance, Insurance, Reinsurance, Chartered, Solicitor, Barrister, Building Society
Any name suggesting a connection with the Republic of Vanuatu or a public authority
Identical or confusingly similar names to an existing registered or reserved name; petroleum, oil and marine-fuel tokens are permissible but will be cross-noted for industry license verification
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A rejected applicant or its Registered Agent may file a written administrative appeal with the Registrar of International Companies at the VFSC within 14 calendar days of the rejection notice, stating the grounds for review and submitting supporting evidence such as regulatory consents or distinctiveness arguments. The Registrar must determine the appeal within 30 working days; an adverse decision may be challenged before the Supreme Court of Vanuatu by judicial review under the Judicial Review Act [Cap. 200].

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permissible for the statutory registered office; every International Company must maintain a physical registered office and a licensed Registered Agent in Vanuatu. A virtual office is acceptable only as a supplementary marketing or correspondence address and does not satisfy the International Companies Act [Cap. 222] or economic substance expectations; for high-risk ISIC 4661 petroleum wholesale trading, the VFSC will scrutinize the substance chain, physical office, local agent and decision-making records.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Elevated: approximately 45% probability of an unannounced physical on-site inspection by the VFSC, VFIU or appointed examiners within the first 12 months of incorporation; near-certain documentary inspection of registered office files, UBO register and AML/CFT records.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: VFSC name search and reservation fee (one primary name)
VFSC International Company registration fee (authorized capital up to USD 50,000)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff (International Companies Act [Cap. 222] and VFSC fee schedule)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certificate of Incorporation issuance and apostille certification of the registration pack
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: VFSC / Office of the Government of Vanuatu (apostille authority)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Licensed Registered Agent and registered office service (first year)
UBO register establishment and confidential beneficial-ownership filing with VFSC
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Regulatory fee plus agent compliance tariff

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML/CFT customer due diligence pack, PEP and sanctions screening (directors, shareholders, UBOs, counterparties)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for high-risk enhanced due diligence

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization of statutory declarations, passport and address verification documents
Apostille / consular legalization certification of the due-diligence bundle (six documents)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Competent apostille authority or Vanuatu consular post

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified translation of non-English or non-French corporate and personal documents
Bank reference and source-of-wealth corroboration charges
International courier and secure document transmission (origin to Port Vila)
Pre-incorporation legal review of energy trading structure, AML screening and license readiness (external counsel)
Contingency pre-consultation for statutory licensing (physical wholesale of marine fuel oil and distillates; high-risk special license)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: VFSC financial-dealer licensing unit / Department of Energy adviser
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Advisory fee benchmark (optional; binding license application fees are post-incorporation)

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act, Cap. 222 (Republic of Vanuatu), ss. 8-12 (incorporation procedure), s. 33 (registered office and agent), ss. 45-51 (directors and first board meeting)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Companies Registry, Port Vila
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Registration of an International Company (Form IC-101) together with the Memorandum and Articles of Association
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital requirement. The authorized share capital may be expressed in any currency; a nominal subscribing capital of USD 1 per issued share is sufficient. No escrow, bank deposit, or proof-of-funds requirement applies at incorporation.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en:
RESOLVED that the Company is validly incorporated under the International Companies Act, Cap. 222, and the subscribers hereby subscribe for 1,000 ordinary shares of USD 1.00 each, fully paid on application.

RESOLVED that the registered office of the Company shall be situated at Port Vila, Vanuatu, and the licensed international agent is appointed as the registered agent.

RESOLVED that the following directors are hereby appointed to hold office until the next annual general meeting: [Full Name], [Full Name].

RESOLVED that the Chairman and Company Secretary are authorized to file the registration certificate, open bank mandates, and perform all corporate acts necessary to implement this resolution, including adoption of the corporate seal and appointment of the first corporate officers.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission – Companies Registry (online portal and counter service)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Conduct a name availability search against the register of international companies. Submit a prescribed Name Reservation Request stating the proposed company name, object of the company, and particulars of the subscriber. Pay the reservation fee and obtain a name reservation certificate valid for 90 days.
required_dossiers: Subscriber’s full name, residential address, and passport copy
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected or queried, file an alternative name reservation promptly; an appeal may be lodged with the Registrar within 21 days of rejection under the International Companies Act.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Notarisation of Constitutional Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC-licensed registered agent and a Vanuatu Notary Public
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the Memorandum and Articles of Association in English, including authorized objects covering physical wholesale brokerage of crude oil and refined petroleum products. Ensure the Articles permit unlimited directors, multiple share classes, and indemnities. Notarize subscriber signatures and obtain notarial attestation of the first directors’ consent.
required_dossiers: Draft Memorandum and Articles of Association
Subscriber identification and proof of address
Notarized consent to act as first director
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If defective provisions are identified by the VFSC, file a revised Memorandum and Articles within 14 days; minor amendments may be made by board resolution without re-notarization.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of Incorporation Application and VFSC Filing
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File Form IC-101 with the notarized Memorandum and Articles, the registered agent’s appointment, and subscriber declarations. Pay the prescribed government filing fee by bank wire or VFSC bank deposit. Upon verification the Registrar issues a Certificate of Incorporation and certified extract of the company register.
required_dossiers: Notarized Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried, respond to the VFSC through the online registry correspondence within 7 business days with curative documentation; resubmission is accepted within 5 working days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First Board Meeting and Corporate Governance Formalities
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Company board, the registered agent, and the VFSC for post-incorporation filings
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting to adopt the pro-forma resolution, issue share certificates, appoint officers, adopt the corporate seal, and approve the bank signatory mandate. File the register of directors and any initial charges with the VFSC within 30 days of incorporation.
required_dossiers: Minutes of the first board resolution
Share certificates and register of members
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If VFSC issues a notice of non-compliance, file a corrective statement and pay any late filing fee; ratify the curative action by board resolution at the next meeting.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Business License and Petroleum Wholesale Brokerage Endorsement
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Department of Industry (Ministry of Trade, Tourism and Investment) and Department of Energy (Ministry of Climate Change and Environment)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply for a Business License under the Business License Act and a Petroleum Wholesale and Supply License under the Petroleum Act. For a pure brokerage activity without physical storage, request a Category C broker/reseller endorsement to avoid bonding requirements. Submit the Certificate of Incorporation, registered office proof, and fire safety approval. Pay the annual license fees.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation of the International Company
Fire safety and building clearance certificate
Tax clearance or tax-exemption confirmation from the Vanuatu Department of Customs and Inland Revenue
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the license is denied or conditioned, file a written appeal to the Director of Industry within 14 days; present a port service agreement proving spill containment and third-party fueling logistics to satisfy safety and environmental objections.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Department of Energy (Ministry of Climate Change and Environment) in conjunction with the Department of Industry (Ministry of Trade, Tourism and Investment)
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Petroleum Wholesale and Supply License (Category C – Broker/Reseller) and Business License (Class 2 – General Trading)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (Vanuatu Environment Protection Agency)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Schedule 2, Tier 2 – Preliminary Environmental Assessment (registration) required for petroleum trading with no on-site storage exceeding 500 tonnes; full EIA required if storage, blending, or loading/unloading terminals are proposed.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Zero liquid discharge to watercourses; volatile organic compound (VOC) emissions compliant with IFC EHS guidelines at 20 g/m³ for transfer racks; waste oil and hydrocarbon residues disposed exclusively through licensed waste carriers under the Vanuatu Waste Management Regulations 2018.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Mandatory fire safety certificate from the Vanuatu Fire and Emergency Services under the Civil Defense Act; annual structural load inspection report for any leased office or jetty facility; occupational health and safety registration from the Department of Labor, including certification of asbestos-free and adequately ventilated work premises.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Revenue and Customs Authority (VRCA) — the merged national authority administering the Value Added Tax Act [Cap. 249], the Customs Act, and all indirect taxes; official portal: www.vrca.gov.vu. Corporate registration and licensing: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), portal: www.vfsc.vu.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1: Incorporate the International Company (IC) with the VFSC under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222], obtaining the Certificate of Incorporation and unique VFSC Company Number. Step 2: Apply to the VFSC for the annual International Company license; no separate tax registration is required because a standard IC is statutorily exempt from all national taxes (including income, capital gains, withholding and stamp duties) and the VFSC license fee substitutes for tax filing obligations. Step 3: If and only if the IC will make taxable supplies in Vanuatu or import goods (e.g., local bunker supply), file Form VRCA-VAT-REG with the VRCA attaching the Certificate of Incorporation, registered office certificate, director passport copies, and business license, to obtain a TIN/VAT registration certificate within approximately 5 to 10 business days. Step 4: For pure offshore brokerage of crude oil/refined products (title, risk, and delivery outside Vanuatu), no VAT registration is required and the IC operates solely on its VFSC number plus any separately obtained energy trading or marine fuel supply license.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box, hybrid mismatch, or consolidated filing elections exist under Vanuatu law. The IC's tax-exempt classification is mandatory and automatic under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222]. An IC may elect to convert into a resident ordinary company under the Companies Act [Cap. 191], thereby relinquishing the exemption and becoming subject to VAT, customs, and all resident obligations; no other elective regimes are available to a non-resident-owned IC.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under the Value Added Tax Act No. 11 of 1998 [Cap. 249]
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VT 5,000,000 aggregate taxable turnover in the preceding 12 months (compulsory registration threshold in Vanuatu Vatu); a purely offshore IC trading crude oil/refined products without local supplies or imports falls below the territorial nexus and is not registrable. Persons below the threshold may apply for voluntary registration.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance, continuous clearance, digital stamping, or API-based e-invoicing mandate exists in Vanuatu. VAT invoices may be issued on paper or in PDF and must state the supplier VAT number, 'tax invoice' designation, date, description, quantity, price, and VAT charged (or 'zero-rated export supply' indication). Customs declarations are filed electronically through the ASYCUDA World system, which assigns an electronic customs entry reference, but this does not constitute tax invoice clearance.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of goods, including marine fuel oil and distillates supplied to international-going vessels, are zero-rated under Schedule 2 of the VAT Act, provided the supplier holds valid VAT registration (or the supply is entirely outside the territorial scope for offshore ICs) and proves removal of the goods from Vanuatu by customs export entry. The supplier must issue a tax invoice marked as an export/zero-rated supply, retain evidence that title and risk passed to a non-resident buyer, and demonstrate settlement in foreign currency. Crude oil and refined product trades brokered by an International Company with delivery, title transfer, and payment occurring entirely offshore are outside the charge to VAT and attract neither 12.5% nor 0% VAT.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (ASYCUDA World export entry) stating HS 2709 (crude petroleum oils) or HS 2710 (petroleum oils, not crude) and the local loading or storage facility
Bill of Lading or Bunker Delivery Note (BDN) evidencing delivery to the international vessel or foreign destination
Inward Remittance Certificate or SWIFT MT103/MT202 cable confirming receipt of foreign-currency proceeds in the IC's nominated bank account within the statutory period

Original VAT 'zero-rated export supply' tax invoice matched to the underlying purchase invoices, tank storage receipts, and the charter or sale confirmation to substantiate the exported quantity and value
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: A false zero-rating claim triggers reassessment clawing back the 12.5% VAT that should have been charged on the supply together with the reversal of any credited input VAT, plus a penalty of up to 100% of the under-assessed tax and interest at 10% per annum. Issuing fictitious tax invoices or knowingly false declarations is an offence under the VAT Act and Customs Act, carrying fines of up to VT 1,000,000 and imprisonment of up to 2 years for directors and officers; deliberate misdeclaration in customs export entries may render the fuel consignment forfeit and expose the IC to civil penalties of up to twice the duty evaded. The VRCA may cancel the VAT registration and the VFSC may strike off the International Company or revoke its energy-trading license for serious fraudulent conduct, with liabilities following the officers and any shadow principals.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV) acting under the Exchange Control Act [Cap 62], with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) as the licensing authority for International Companies and foreign exchange dealers.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Vanuatu accepts IMF Article VIII obligations, so current-account payments and transfers are generally unrestricted. The Vatu (VUV) is not a globally tradable currency; spot liquidity is shallow and offshore accounts are normally maintained in USD for petroleum settlements. Capital-account convertibility is de facto available to non-resident International Companies because the IC regime prohibits carrying on business with Vanuatu residents, effectively ring-fencing profits offshore. Profit remittance via dividend or capital redemption is not subject to exchange control approval for a validly licensed IC, but must be executed through an authorised commercial bank with supporting corporate documentation.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Vanuatu currently imposes no mandatory export-proceeds surrender timeline and no minimum VUV conversion ratio. A licensed International Company engaged in ISIC 4661 wholesale crude oil and refined products may retain export receipts in USD or any other freely usable foreign currency. If a bank receives a VUV payment on behalf of the IC as an exception, the proceeds can be converted to USD under the bank's normal FX capacity without statutory surrender. The operative obligation is documentary: the bank will expect the underlying sales contract, invoice, bill of lading, and SWIFT payment reference to demonstrate a genuine trade transaction.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account (USD) and Operational Settlement Account (USD/VUV)
Capital Escrow Account (USD) and Operational Settlement Account (USD/VUV)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low for the primary treasury route. Vanuatu does not maintain a dedicated e-money institution framework for foreign-currency clearing, and offshore digital EMIs are not VFSC-regulated as banks. Such EMIs cannot issue or clear VUV-denominated instruments, do not provide documentary credit services, and are generally unacceptable for high-value petroleum cargo settlements. They may be used only as auxiliary non-VUV payment wallets where the trade counterparty accepts lower documentary standards, but the principal corporate banking relationship must remain with a licensed commercial bank or a reputable foreign correspondent bank.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Most Vanuatu commercial banks require at least one director or the ultimate beneficial owner to attend a face-to-face interview at branch level before opening a high-risk petroleum-trading account. Remote onboarding is technically possible through notarised corporate documents, certified passports, and a video conference with the compliance officer, but for an International Company trading ISIC 4661 commodities the bank will usually condition approval on an in-person interview in Port Vila. A physical office presence is not mandatory under the International Companies Act, but the bank may request a registered agent confirmation and a letter of good standing from the VFSC.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk petroleum commodity classification under bank AML risk-tiering, resulting in automatic enhanced due diligence and possible rejection.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide a VFSC International Company certificate, valid trading licence for wholesale of crude oil and refined products, anti-money-laundering manual containing customer due diligence procedures, sanction screening policy, trade compliance framework, and a detailed business narrative identifying all supply-chain counterparties.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Opaque beneficial ownership structure or historical use of bearer shares, which many Vanuatu ICs previously employed.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Submit a certified register of registered shares, notarised declarations of beneficial ownership, a registered-agent compliance certificate, and a written commitment to maintain no bearer instruments, signed by each director and the ultimate beneficial owner.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Source-of-funds ambiguity for first capital injection, particularly where the injecting shareholder resides in an OFAC/EU high-risk jurisdiction.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Bank statements of the transferring entity covering at least 12 months, audited financial statements, board resolution approving the capital injection, a source-of-wealth declaration, and copies of the underlying commercial contracts demonstrating that the funds arise from legitimate energy trading or asset ownership.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions and proliferation-finance red flags arising from petroleum refined-product counterparties in unverified jurisdictions.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Real-time sanctions screening reports on all beneficial owners, counterparties, vessels, and freight forwarders; International Chamber of Commerce terms for supply contracts; Incoterms 2020 documentary trail; and a written confirmation that no transaction involves a restricted party under UN, OFAC, EU, UK, or Vanuatu sanctions.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Capital injections must be routed by SWIFT MT103 from the non-resident shareholder to the IC's USD account at a licensed Vanuatu commercial bank. The free-text narrative in field 70 should read: 'CAPITAL CONTRIBUTION – VU_IC, ISIC 4661 PETROLEUM PRODUCTS, VFSC REGISTRATION [NUMBER]'. The bank will request a board resolution, updated share registry, and source-of-funds statement before crediting the account. Purpose-code specific to Vanuatu IC disbursement is not required by the central bank, but using the widely accepted ISO 20022 reason 'COST' or 'INTC' may create confusion; a clear free-text plus documentary backup is safer.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound settlements for physical refined-product purchases should be executed through a SWIFT MT103 wire for direct transfers or through a commercial documentary letter of credit (MT700/MT707) for cargo transactions. The recommended rail is a confirmed irrevocable LC at sight with full set of shipping documents, followed by SWIFT MT103 for any balance after certificate of quantity and quality. For term contracts, a standby letter of credit (SBLC, MT760) can secure performance guarantees and advance-payment guarantees. All outbound disbursements must reference the underlying invoice number, contract date, intended vessel, and cargo grade to support the bank's transaction monitoring.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore deliverable VUV/USD forward contract with an authorised commercial bank in Vanuatu
Offshore non-deliverable VUV/USD forward (NDF) with a top-tier global bank where VUV settlement is not economically practicable
Cross-currency USD/VUV swap for matching long-dated trade liabilities and refinancing exposures
Vanilla FX option structures (calls and puts) in USD/VUV or firmly traded commodity currencies such as USD/SGD and USD/HKD, subject to the counterparty's credit approval
FX swap for simultaneous spot and forward conversion when entering and exiting temporary trade funding liquidity positions

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual International Company Renewal Fee and Tax-Exempt Status Confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) - International Companies Register
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Payable on or before the anniversary date of incorporation; VFSC practice permits a 30-day late payment grace period after which penalty accrues
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: 10% late payment penalty imposed after 30 days past the anniversary date; continued non-payment for 90 days after formal notice triggers administrative strike-off, forfeiture of assets, and loss of legal standing

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered Agent Annual Compliance Certification (Updated Register of Directors and Members)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registered Agent Licensed by VFSC; copy maintained at Vanuatu registered office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days after each incorporation anniversary; agent must confirm current directors, members, and registered office details
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to certify may be treated as non-maintenance of a registered office; VFSC may impose a VUV fine and ultimately strike off the company after repeated non-compliance

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory independent audit required for Vanuatu International Companies under the International Companies Act, regardless of revenue, assets, or number of shareholders; audit may only become contractually necessary under bank financing, Standby Letter of Credit arrangements, or buyer/supplier credit documentation
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No mandatory accounting standard imposed by law for International Companies; IFRS or US GAAP may be adopted at management discretion for counterparty financial reporting and commodity trade finance purposes

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Vanuatu maintains no public beneficial ownership register; the registered agent is required to keep an internal register of members and beneficial owners. On each annual renewal, the agent must confirm to VFSC that current UBO information has been obtained and that any share transfers executed during the year have been recorded in the company's register of members. Material shareholding changes are documented by board resolution and agent record update only; they are not filed publicly with VFSC except in the case of a director change.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 400-1,200 per annum for a licensed VFSC registered agent and registered office in Vanuatu
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not statutorily required; optional certified audit for trade finance and LC structuring typically ranges from USD 5,000-12,000 per engagement

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0.00% - zero headline rate. The Republic of Vanuatu imposes no corporate income tax, no capital gains tax, no branch profits tax, and no alternative minimum tax. An International Company registered under the International Companies Act (Cap 222) is entirely exempt from domestic income taxation.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Effective rate: 0.00%. Full statutory exemption for International Companies covers income from physical wholesale brokerage of marine fuel oil, crude oil, and refined distillates conducted outside Vanuatu. No payroll tax applies to non-resident staff; no net worth or property tax targets offshore receivables. VAT at 12.5% under the Value Added Tax Act 1998 applies only to domestic supplies and is ineffective on offshore export commissions. The only recurring fiscal charges are the annual VFSC licence fee and the annual economic substance filing.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: International Company Annual Return and Annual Licence Fee (Form IC-AR / ELF-CUSTOM-VU-IC), filed electronically through the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) eServices Portal by the licensed resident agent in Port Vila.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due on or before the anniversary date of incorporation each year. A late fee equal to 20% of the annual licence fee is levied after a 30-day grace period, and VFSC may suspend the company and initiate strike-off proceedings after continued default of three months.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered corporate name and International Company registration number (IC-####).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State the exact legal name as shown on the Certificate of Incorporation; do not add trade names, branch references, or group suffixes.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Date of incorporation and anniversary date used for annual fee computation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Copy from the certificate of incorporation; the registered agent selects the fee bracket; no turnover declaration is required for this box.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered office address in Vanuatu, being the physical street address of the licensed agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the agent's Port Vila street address; a P.O. Box alone is invalid; a mailbox may supplement but never replace the physical address.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Licensed resident agent identification, VFSC licence number, and signature.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The non-resident beneficial owner does not sign; the licensed resident agent is the statutory filer and bears local liability for accuracy.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Economic substance declaration: relevant activity conducted or 'none'.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For marine fuel and distillate wholesale brokerage involving storage, distribution, or logistics for foreign group companies, tick 'distribution and service centre business'; pure agency trading on a disclosed principal basis should be declared as such for ESR assessment.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Confirmation of offshore/non-domestic activity and absence of Vanuatu-source revenue.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Declare nil domestic vatable supplies; retain trade confirmations, SWIFT advices, and freight contracts for audit inspection.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late payment attracts a 20% surcharge on the annual licence fee plus VUV 1,000 per month of continued default. VFSC may deregister the International Company after three months of arrears; restoration requires a court order, full arrears and penalties, restoration fees, and exposes directors to disqualification.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Value Added Tax Return (Form VRF-001) filed with the Vanuatu Customs and Inland Revenue Service, Ministry of Finance, Port Vila, by VAT-registered persons.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Monthly for large registered persons; quarterly for all other registered persons; the exempt International Company files only if voluntarily registered for domestic activity.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due on the last day of the month immediately following the end of the taxable period, e.g., first quarter due on 30 April. No extension is permitted for offshore entities unless a written deferral is granted by the Commissioner.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Value of vatable supplies made in Vanuatu, i.e., domestic sales of goods and services net of exempt supplies.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Insert NIL for the International Company's offshore brokerage and SBLC-settled ex-Vanuatu fuel deliveries; only report commissions earned from domestic Vanuatu agents.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Zero-rated supplies exported from Vanuatu, including bunker fuel physically delivered to international vessels in Vanuatu waters.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report only physically supplied bunker volumes in Vanuatu waters where the IC takes title; paper-only re-invoicing is outside the VAT net and must not be entered.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Output VAT collected at 12.5% on Box V1.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Remain NIL unless the IC has a Vanuatu-source supply, which contradicts the offshore model.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Input VAT recoverable on Vanuatu costs such as legal fees and agent commissions.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter only VAT-bearing invoices addressed to the IC; VFSC licence fees are exempt and do not generate a claim.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net VAT payable or refund due.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a pure offshore IC, remain zero; any positive amount signals domestic activity in need of restructuring.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: civil penalty of VUV 10,000 per return plus VUV 2,000 per additional month of default. Late payment: interest of 5% per month capped at 60%. Deliberate misdeclaration attracts a fraud penalty of 150% of evaded VAT and criminal prosecution with imprisonment under the VAT Act 1998.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0.00% - no dividend withholding tax is imposed in Vanuatu. The International Companies Act 1992 prohibits any withholding on dividends, redemption proceeds, or capital distributions of an International Company; non-resident shareholders are paid gross without declaration or prior ruling.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Vanuatu has no comprehensive double taxation agreement network; only tax information exchange agreements (TIEAs) exist with certain treaty partners. No DTA claim is necessary to reduce a Vanuatu dividend withholding tax because none is imposed. Where a foreign shareholder requires evidence of tax residence, the resident agent applies in writing to the Vanuatu Ministry of Finance and Customs and Inland Revenue Office, attaching a notarised board resolution and the latest VFSC annual return; a certificate of offshore tax residence is generally issued within five to ten business days and should be retained with the TRC proof pack for seven years.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory rate: 0.00% on royalties for trademarks, charters, and IP licences paid by an International Company, and 0.00% on interest under loan notes and shareholder debt. Treaty rate: N/A - no comprehensive tax treaty modifies the domestic zero rate; filing of interest and royalty flows is nonetheless recommended for BEPS documentation and substance benchmarking.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No statutory transfer pricing threshold is codified in Vanuatu in VUV, and no Local File or Master File obligation is imposed by the Income Tax regime. However, the International Companies (Economic Substance) Act 2019 requires an annual economic substance filing for any relevant activity; for ISIC 4661 wholesale fuel brokerage, the IC must evidence arm's-length pricing and real operational expenditure against controlled turnover of any size, including single-transaction SBLC routing. In practical VFSC administration, intensive substance review is triggered where annual controlled turnover exceeds VUV 150 million (approximately USD 1.25 million) or where intercompany commissions dominate the profit and loss statement.
approved_arm_length_methodologies: CUP - Comparable Uncontrolled Price, benchmarked against Platts and Argus marine fuel assessments
Resale Price Method - for distribution and service centre buy-resell structures
Cost Plus Method - for contract broker service fees
Transactional Net Margin Method - for routine entity with EBITDA margin between 1.5% and 3.0%
Profit Split Method - for integrated trading desks with risk and inventory functions split across group entities
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Applicable. The International Companies (Economic Substance) Act 2019, as amended 2021, extends to International Companies conducting 'distribution and service centre business', which captures commodity wholesale brokerage when goods are procured from or sold to a foreign group member or connected non-resident. The IC must demonstrate central management and control in Vanuatu: board meetings at the registered office, local physical premises, qualified employees proportionate to the trade, a local bank account at a licensed Vanuatu bank for trade flows, and annual local operating expenditure reflective of the business. Failure renders the company subject to VFSC information requests, penalties up to VUV 5,000,000, daily default fines, licence suspension, and strike-off.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion by False Offshore Declaration (VAT and Customs Fraud)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Directing domestic on-island sales of refined fuel or bunker supplies to Vanuatu residents through the International Company while declaring 'no domestic activity' on Box 6 of Form IC-AR and Box V1 of the VAT return, or diverting a higher commission to a foreign affiliate to shrink the IC's auditable substance footprint.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: VAT Act 1998: fraud penalty of 150% of the tax evaded plus fines up to VUV 50,000 per false return. Customs Act: forfeiture of goods and excise-equivalent penalties for smuggling concealment. Penal Code: imprisonment up to 7 years and criminal fines up to VUV 100,000 upon conviction.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Non-resident directors who sign or instruct the false declaration are treated as principals; courts may pierce the corporate veil to order civil restitution of evaded VAT, issue travel bans and departure prohibition orders pending payment, and impose personal fines with imprisonment up to 7 years where fraud is proven.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Sham Booking Vehicle (Denial of Economic Substance)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the International Company purely as an invoicing and profit-stripping shell for crude and refined product trades negotiated and contracted in Singapore or the Middle East, with no decisions, staff, premises, or bank oversight in Vanuatu, while booking a non-arm's-length margin to the IC to strip group profit.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: International Companies (Economic Substance) Act 2019: penalty up to VUV 5,000,000 plus VUV 50,000 per day of continued default. VFSC may refuse licence renewal, strike the IC off the register without limitation of liability, issue an adverse substance finding, and exchange the finding with treaty partners under the TIEA network.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and the resident agent may be jointly ordered to pay penal sums as civil restitution, face prohibition from acting as a director for up to 5 years, be subjected to travel bans as enforcement measures, and, where false substance notices were filed, imprisonment not exceeding 2 years.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML/CFT and Financial Sanctions Failure (High-Risk Energy Commodity Trading)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Handling marine fuel and distillate trades financed by standby letters of credit or SWIFT wire transfers through third-country transit banks without customer due diligence, without identifying the end-buyer of crude oil, and failing to file suspicious transaction reports for non-documentary transfers from high-risk jurisdictions.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: AML/CFT Act 2017 and Financial Intelligence Unit regulations: civil monetary penalties up to VUV 10,000,000 per breach, licence suspension or revocation of operational authorisation; money laundering is a predicate offence punishable by up to 15 years imprisonment and criminal fines up to VUV 15,000,000; asset freeze orders and confiscation of trade proceeds are mandatory on conviction.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, compliance officers, and ultimate beneficial owners carry personal criminal liability; courts can order civil forfeiture of the SBLC proceeds, impose travel bans, revoke Vanuatu work or residence permits, and imprison the directing mind for up to 15 years where laundering is established.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Transfer Pricing Mispricing and Camouflaged Profit Shifting
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Reporting an arm's-length margin of 0.01% on multi-million-dollar marine fuel trades, or paying artificial marketing and consultancy fees to a connected zero-tax entity to drain profit while the residual accumulates at the Vanuatu IC without corresponding risk absorption, employees, or operating expenditure.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Vanuatu imposes no direct transfer pricing penalty; however, VFSC will treat the entity as lacking economic substance and impose ESR fines up to VUV 5,000,000. The residence state of the shareholder will commonly make a BEPS secondary adjustment with penalties of 20% to 40% of the under-reported amount, and TIEA exchange exposes the full pricing documentation and banking trail.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors approving the mispricing face fiduciary claims for the lost value, civil restitution orders enforceable against offshore assets, travel bans during asset tracing, and, for deliberate misrepresentation to VFSC on the annual return, imprisonment up to 2 years.
